projects.name: Fetch.ai / Flockx
projects.description: Senior backend engineer and full-stack developer for Flockx.io's AI agent workflow platform built with Next.js. Architected LangGraph-based agent orchestration with RAG-powered chat over WebSocket, plus API routes, authentication systems, and data transformation pipelines while managing AWS S3, Cloudinary, and Redis. Implemented performance optimizations, database migrations, ElasticSearch integration, and third-party services like Intercom and Slack.

projects.name: Whole Earth Curriculum
projects.description: A single, coherent, drop-in K–12 curriculum built by an agent loop across nearly two billion tokens, made affordable by DeepSeek. Free and open source — develops people who are emotionally, physically, and intellectually aware of themselves, their context, and the Earth they live on.

projects.name: ISCPO.org
projects.description: Architected and delivered ISCPO.org as a WordPress membership platform that preserved native editorial workflows, reduced config drift, and made key site structure reproducible across environments. Built with Sage 11, Acorn 5, Blade, and a disciplined plugin/theme boundary so the organization kept the WordPress ecosystem it relied on while the codebase gained Laravel-style structure and a faster developer workflow.

projects.name: ABowlofRed.com
projects.description: Orchestrated the development of ABowlofRed.com, originally a Gatsby-based front-end that migrated to Astro for improved performance and developer experience. Utilized Strapi CMS on AWS EC2 with Node.js for content management, and integrated Stripe for secure ticket transactions that have surpassed $130,000 in annual ticket sales.

projects.name: The Concert on Lake Grapevine
projects.description: Co-developed and produced the site for a family-friendly charity concert benefiting Grapevine charities, presented by Tolbert's Restaurant & Chili Parlor and The Charity Grapevine. Covers lineup, FAQ, sponsors, and Stripe-powered ticketing for a full day of live music on the lake.

projects.name: Pulse COOP
projects.description: Co-founded a worker-owned technology cooperative dedicated to empowering local businesses and grassroots movements. As a founding member, I helped establish democratic workplace practices based on the seven cooperative principles while delivering tech solutions that strengthen community economic foundations.

projects.name: MCP Server Suite
projects.description: A family of safety-first MCP servers that give AI assistants governed, read-only access to real systems: PostgreSQL (mcp-pg-db-reader), MySQL (mysql-db-reader), and Mezmo log retrieval (mezmo-logs-mcp), plus work on godot-mcp for AI-assisted game development. Built around the idea that AI tooling should be auditable, quota-conscious, and hard to misuse.

projects.name: Propane.com
projects.description: Spearheaded the development of Propane.com, an enterprise-level WordPress site featuring advanced customizations and integrations. Implemented a robust CI pipeline, 2FA authentication via OAuth Okta, and developed stateful web applications. Integrated Algolia for advanced search and HubSpot for CRM, and optimized React-based components for performance.

projects.name: Tolbert's Restaurant
projects.description: Architected a high-performance restaurant website using Astro with a headless WordPress CMS backend. Integrated third-party menu systems and food ordering platforms through custom API routes, with dynamic calendar integration, contact forms, and seamless third-party connections — all while maintaining accessibility and performance standards.

projects.name: Chisos
projects.description: Developed, deployed, and provisioned a full-stack note-taking application that transcribes speech to text and uses AI to organize notes for later analysis. Handled all infrastructure provisioning on Railway, secure authentication with Clerk, and AI services for core functionality. Built with Vite and TanStack Router for a modern, type-safe experience.

projects.name: Steel Calculator
projects.description: A specialized steel calculator built for a steel-industry professional to make daily work easier. Simple, focused, and actually used — proof that the most valuable tool is often the least flashy one.
